name: Northern Mariana Islands

law.summary: EPA Region 9 issues the permits. No public-notice duty for sewage spills found; BECQ red-flags beaches for 48 hours on its weekly results.

regulator_report.deadline: 24 hours oral, 5 days written (EPA permit standard condition)

erule.notes: Three collection systems registered, no events.

beaches.program: BECQ Water Quality Surveillance / NPS program, weekly red and green flags

barriers.what: No sewage spill notices from CUC found
Red-flag email list joined on request

readiness.rationale: No overflow reports; a good weekly beach advisory page with a stated 48-hour window.

owner_questions: BECQ's red flag carries its own 48-hour window: show it as the authority's red window?
surprise: The CNMI's weekly beach page is one of the cleanest advisory records in the territories (466 weekly reports since 2022, site codes, an explicit 48-hour, 300-foot advice), yet no sewage spill is reported anywhere.
